nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set from msg.sender in Owned constructor and used by onlyOwner.
Pending owner address recorded by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Public token symbol string, set to FRELLY in the FrellyToken constructor.
Public token name string set in the FrellyToken constructor.
Public token decimals (uint8), set to 0 in the constructor.
Internal total token supply, set to 1 and minted to the deployer address.
Mapping of account address to token balance used by transfer/transferFrom/balanceOf.
Nested mapping of owner to spender allowances used by approve/transferFrom/allowance.
SafeMath helper performing checked addition c = a + b with require(c >= a).
SafeMath helper performing checked subtraction c = a - b with require(b <= a).
SafeMath helper performing checked multiplication with division-based overflow check.
SafeMath helper performing division with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor assigning owner = msg.sender.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner before executing the guarded function.
onlyOwner function that stores a pending new owner in newOwner.
Function requiring msg.sender == newOwner, then promoting newOwner to owner.
Constructor initializing symbol/name/decimals/_totalSupply and minting the full supply.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens, without resetting to zero first.
Spends allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Returns the remaining allowance of spender for tokenOwner.
Approves spender and then calls spender.receiveApproval with user-controlled data.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner function that calls an arbitrary token contract to transfer tokens to owner.
msg.sender compared against owner inside the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender used to initialize the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
msg.sender used as the debited key in transfer and as event source.
msg.sender used as the allowance owner key in approve.
msg.sender used as the spender key when decrementing allowed in transferFrom.
msg.sender used as allowance owner key and forwarded to the callee in approveAndCall.
msg.sender compared against newOwner in acceptOwnership to authorize ownership transfer.
Unchecked 256-bit addition c = a + b inside safeAdd (pre-0.8 overflow semantics).
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub guarded only by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul with division-based overflow check.
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender,tokens,this,data) with attacker-controlled spender and data.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner,tokens) to a caller-supplied contract address.

edges.reason: Owned constructor initializes owner directly from untrusted msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier reads msg.sender to compare against owner.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner as an authorization check.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
transfer debits balances keyed by untrusted msg.sender.
transfer delegates balance decrement to safeSub.
transfer delegates balance increment to safeAdd.
transfer writes updated balances mapping entries.
approve writes the allowance using untrusted msg.sender as the owner key.
approve directly overwrites allowed[msg.sender][spender] without zeroing.
transferFrom uses untrusted msg.sender as the spender key in allowed.
transferFrom decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping for from and to.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance increment.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] using untrusted msg.sender.
approveAndCall updates the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on a caller-supplied contract address.
The external spender contract can call back into the token during receiveApproval.
FrellyToken constructor sets the symbol state variable.
FrellyToken constructor sets the name state variable.
FrellyToken constructor sets the decimals state variable.
FrellyToken constructor sets _totalSupply to 1.
FrellyToken constructor mints the whole supply into the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] for the burn adjustment.
totalSupply performs an unguarded subtraction outside SafeMath.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
safeAdd executes the unchecked addition operation.
safeSub executes the subtraction operation.
safeMul executes the multiplication operation.
safeDiv executes the division operation.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
The arbitrary ERC20 contract can reenter the token during the external transfer call.
